name: To My Darling
source:
Mimiko Nakamura, a third year at White Lily Junior High, wants to give her crush a love letter after school. Trouble arises when her classmates have other plans for her.

[From [url=https://ixkyu.itch.io/to-my-darling]itch.io[/url]]
